body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Ballistic, designers of advanced mobile accessories, will be debuting its newest creation, the Ballistic LS, at CES 2011. Over the past year, Ballistic has released two other award-winning protective case models, the HC (Hard Core) and SG (Shell Gel), both of which have received massive recognition around the country.

The Ballistic LS is the next big name in the durable case market. It is made of strong TPU material and silicone Ballistic Corners™. This case offers the best of both worlds— its ultra-sleek profile creates minimal bulk, but still provides maximum protection.

What differentiates this case from competitor's is the included interchangeable corner bumpers with different thickness options. This allows for the ultimate customization of shock absorption preference. Additional corner bumpers of varying thicknesses and colors will be available separately.

"We have spent the past year working diligently to provide customers the best protective solutions for their mobile devices, that had never been seen before," said Adam Stubin, VP of Business Development, Ballistic. "We have emerged as a market leader by delivering top-notch protective, yet stylish cases, and we are thrilled to debut our next product at this year's Consumer Electronics Show."
Be the first to see Ballistic's newest iPhone 4 case, the Ballistic LS, at the Ballistic Suite in The Wynn Hotel.
To set up a meeting at CES, or to request more information or images, please contact PR representative Kristen Bean at (305) 576-1171 x23 or kristenbean@maxborgesagency.com.
The Ballistic LS will be available January 2011 for $29.99 in a variety of sleek colors, at www.goballisticcase.com.

The Ballistic® brand was realized 6 years ago when the owner was getting out of his car and his phone fell, cracking the screen. He believed there had to be a way to offer consumers a high level of protection in a case that still looked good.
The Ballistic engineers designed private label holsters and belt clips that simply would not break. During this time, the company made millions of OEM branded holsters and belt clips.

As smart phones became more popular, the need for drop protection became necessary. Ballistic engineers examined their competitor's products and knew they could do better. The result is now a line of a variety of Ballistic cases. These cases provide the most advanced degree of drop protection currently in the market.
We think everyone will drop their phone. We say, "Just Drop It!"--as long as you are using a Ballistic case. Ballistic cases are Designed to Survive Life!™
